notes: «وبهذا الاسناد، عن سلمة»: prev1 opens with a back reference and has no written chain, so the walk goes to prev2, whose chain writes «أبي» and «سعد بن عبد الله» before «سلمة»; those two are inherited.
«أخيه معمر»: «أخيه» plus a name is one link, surface «معمر» (rule 7).
The text's «بهذا الاسناد» is not written again as a back_reference, since the names are inherited.

fixes.reason: THQ's English gives the route Hasan bin Yusuf, Uthman bin Jabala, Dharees, which is the route of prev1; this reading inherits from prev2 and continues with Salama.

evidence.quote: وبهذا الاسناد، عن سلمة، عن عمر بن سعيد بن خثيم
With this chain of narrators, from Hasan bin Yusuf, from Uthman bin Jabala, from Dharees ibn Abdul-Malik,
